methodology.objective: Provide historical signal snapshots so AI Arena can simulate a wider date range.
important_controls: Backtest future-return columns are moved to backtest_diagnostics and are not used as signal features.
Existing live Daily snapshots are not overwritten unless AI_ARENA_HISTORICAL_OVERWRITE=true.
